title: RigProfile

filters.description: Filter name to bandpass in nanometres, or null where the bandpass is not known.

colour.description: A one-shot colour camera: broadband RGB, whatever is in front of it.

rotation.description:
The camera's position angle in degrees when nothing can turn it. Null when a rotator can
set whatever angle a project asks for.

typicalHfr.description: Typical star size on this rig, arcseconds.

typicalGuideRms.description: Typical guiding error on this rig, arcseconds.

exposures.description:
The sub length this rig shoots each filter at, seconds: what its darks are built for.
Work is dealt at these lengths so every frame can be calibrated.

hoursPerNight.description: Hours a night the rig gives the collaboration. Null means as long as targets are up.

windowFrom.description: Start of the rig's window, local clock time such as "21:00".

windowTo.description: End of the rig's window, local clock time.

scale.description: Arcseconds per pixel, worked out by the program from the optics.

field.description: Field of view, [width, height] in degrees, worked out by the program.

description:
What a telescope is and what it achieves, sent with every hello. Numbers the program does
not know are null. The server uses this to say whether the rig can help a project and to
cut its cells and deal its nights.
